description_en: Lists the business spaces for your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号的业务空间列表
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot list-agent --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --agent-name '业务空间_001' --goods-codes G_cloudBeeBot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgent

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值100，默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the business space. Use this parameter to filter the results
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间名称，按照名称检索
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The commodity code. Filters the results to return only business spaces associated with a specific commodity code
parameters.help_zh: 商品code，可按照商品code进行过滤，查询实例信息
parameters.name: goods_codes
